channel.title: Field Notes
channel.description: Notes from a developer's workbench: small discoveries, build logs and longer write-ups.

item.title: Rethinking connection pooling on a small budget
item.description: Clear error messages saved more time than any clever optimisation. The real constraint was not the CPU but the number of open file descriptors.

item.title: Simplifying error budgets on a small budget
item.description: Most of the latency came from a single synchronous call that nobody remembered adding. The migration ran in batches so it could be paused, resumed and verified at each step.

item.title: Untangling structured logging from first principles
item.description: Moving the work off the request path made the page fast and the queue honest. The first measurement was misleading because the cache was already warm.

item.title: Debugging dependency updates after a long weekend
item.description: Logs were useful only after every line carried a request identifier. Measuring before and after turned a hunch into a result I could defend.

item.title: Debugging TLS termination in production
item.description: The configuration file had grown three ways to say the same thing. Small, frequent releases made each change easy to reason about and easy to revert.

item.title: Shipping background jobs without downtime
item.description: Logs were useful only after every line carried a request identifier. The benchmark looked impressive until I ran it on the same hardware as production.

item.title: Simplifying structured logging after a long weekend
item.description: The profiler pointed at serialisation, which was not where I would have guessed. Measuring before and after turned a hunch into a result I could defend.

item.title: Automating background jobs after a long weekend
item.description: Most of the latency came from a single synchronous call that nobody remembered adding. I deleted more code than I added, and the system got faster and easier to read.

item.title: Simplifying service workers without downtime

item.title: Simplifying feature flags in production
item.description: Tail latency told a different story from the average, which looked perfectly healthy. Every abstraction leaked a little, and the leaks were where the bugs lived.

item.title: Hardening CSS container queries under load
